author: Dylan Stableford
title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs trial live updates: Cassie Ventura returns to the witness stand for day 2 of cross-examination - Yahoo
description: The 55-year-old hip-hop mogul has been charged by federal prosecutors with sex trafficking, racketeering conspiracy and transportation to engage in...
content_summary: The ongoing federal trial against Sean 'Diddy' Combs involves serious accusations including sex trafficking and racketeering. Key witness Cassie Ventura, Combs's pregnant ex-girlfriend, testified about a decade of abuse involving coercive, drug-fueled sexual encounters. Defense presented texts suggesting consent. Additional witnesses described witnessing abuse. The trial continues in Manhattan and may last over eight weeks.

author: Ted Johnson
title: Donald Trump Says Taylor Swift Is No Longer "Hot" After He Had Posted About His Hate For Her - Deadline
description: The president credited his previousl post saying that he hated her.
content_summary: Donald Trump claimed on social media that Taylor Swift is no longer 'hot' following his public declaration of hatred toward her. Swift's political endorsements of Democrats and criticism of Trump led to this public dispute. The interaction highlights the blend of celebrity culture with political polarization and social media dynamics.

author: Scott Neuman
title: Man who attacked author Salman Rushdie is sentenced to 25 years in prison - NPR
description: Hadi Matar got the maximum sentence for attempted murder. He was found guilty in February for repeatedly stabbing author Salman Rushdie during a 2022 lecture and wounding another person on stage.
content_summary: Hadi Matar was sentenced to 25 years, the maximum for attempted murder, for his 2022 stabbing attack on author Salman Rushdie during a public lecture. The attack caused serious injuries including partial blindness. The assault ties back to a fatwa issued against Rushdie in 1989. Matar faces additional federal terrorism charges.

title: UK court orders singer Chris Brown held in custody over 2023 London nightclub fight charge - CNN
description: Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown was ordered held in custody after appearing Friday in a British courtroom to face a charge that he seriously beat a music producer in a London nightclub in 2023.
content_summary: Chris Brown has been ordered held in custody by a UK court pending further hearings related to an alleged 2023 assault on a music producer in a London nightclub. Bail was denied. The legal case impacts his international tour schedule and adds to his controversial history.
